## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 37. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke frames the job first: following up Curt Cignetti and Bob Chesney was going to be an unenviable task for anybody, but it's 'Sun Belt Billy' who gets the chance. He does not soften the recent record — his stint in Gainesville was an abject disaster — but immediately balances it: he was really good at Louisiana, winning 40 games in four seasons, and he inherited a solid foundation from Mark Hudspeth there and gets the same here with the Dukes. His explanation is about fit rather than ability: Florida is a different beast and some guys just aren't built for that burden. His conclusion assigns the risk elsewhere — if JMU struggles, it'll likely be less about Napier and more about the mass exodus of talent over the last two seasons.
